title: Book One · Chapter 93: The First Turn at the Basin
story:
Miss Wu asks Ronan to help with the test line.

He may call one group at a time. He must check the basin table after each test. Then he can call the next group.

Leo waves from the second row. Ronan sees him and puts his name near the top of the list.

Mei looks at the list. “We were meant to go by tables.”

“Leo's boat is ready.”

“So is theirs.”

She points to the far table. A boy is holding a dry model. He waits for several minutes. He keeps the strings away from his sleeve. He does not want them to catch there.

Ronan looks back at the list. Ronan felt important when Miss Wu gave him this job. Now the other children are waiting for their turns. They will hear the first name on his list.

He rubs out Leo's name. He presses too hard. A small tear opens in the paper.

“I have to use the table order,” he says.

Leo pulls a face but nods. The far group comes first. Their boat turns in a circle when they blow across the water. Ronan wants to watch the whole test. He nearly forgets the next name.

Miss Wu touches the list with a finger. He looks down and calls the next group clearly.

When Leo's turn comes, he brings the string boat with two partners. One wants to put the stones in. The other wants to blow. Leo starts talking over both.

“Stones today,” Ronan says.

“I know.”

“And wait for the marks.”

“I know that too.”

Ronan hears his own voice become rather like an angry teacher's. Mei is watching from her seat. He takes a step back.

Leo's group finishes one test. The second partner puts a stone near the side, and the boat tilts. They want another try immediately.

The next group is already standing.

“One test for each group first,” Ronan says.

Leo opens his mouth. Then he looks at the waiting children and carries the boat away.

At the end, “Did your list work?” Miss Wu asks Ronan.

“Mostly.”

“What did you change?”

He shows her the rubbed place. He says Leo's name. “I changed the order myself,” he tells her.

“I put him first because he is my friend.”

Miss Wu nods. “You changed it before the test. Next time use the table order.”

She takes the list back. She has exercise books to return. One child needs to go home early too. Ronan leaves the list and goes back to his seat.

At break, Leo sits beside him on the wall.

“You sounded very grand.”

“You wanted another turn.”

“I did.”

Ronan thinks. “I tried to sound very sure.”

“You only knew the list.”

Both boys laugh. Ronan feels a little embarrassed too. Leo is right about the list.

Leo offers him half of a small cake. Ronan takes the smaller piece before Leo can compare them. For several minutes, they eat quietly. They leave the boat talk until later. “May I look at the repaired list?” Leo asks. He wants to count all the turns altogether.
studyGuide:
## 重点表达

- order＝顺序
- partner＝搭档
- immediately＝马上
- altogether＝总共

额外情节词（不要求本章全部记住）：sleeve＝衣袖；tilts＝倾斜；embarrassed＝不好意思的。

## 读句提示

**I put him first because he is my friend.**

我把他排第一／因为他是我的朋友。because只说明一个清楚的原因，先后人物明确。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan一开始怎样偏向了朋友？
2. 他怎样维持规则，又发现自己语气的问题？
